name: io.github.mhajder/netbox-mcp
description: MCP server for NetBox DCIM/IPAM with read-only and dry-run modes
title: NetBox MCP

environmentVariables.name: NETBOX_URL
environmentVariables.description: NetBox base URL (e.g., https://netbox.example.com)

environmentVariables.name: NETBOX_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: NetBox API token: v2 (nbt_<key>.<token>, NetBox 4.5+) or legacy v1

environmentVariables.name: NETBOX_VERIFY_SSL
environmentVariables.description: Verify SSL certificates (true/false)

environmentVariables.name: NETBOX_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Total time allowed for one NetBox request, retries included (seconds)

environmentVariables.name: NETBOX_BRANCHING_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Enable netbox-branching support: branch tools and the 'branch' argument (requires the netbox-branching plugin) (true/false)

environmentVariables.name: NETBOX_BRANCH
environmentVariables.description: Default netbox-branching branch (name or schema ID) for every call; requires NETBOX_BRANCHING_ENABLED=true

environmentVariables.name: NETBOX_PLUGIN_DISCOVERY
environmentVariables.description: Discover plugin object types from /api/core/object-types/ (true/false)

environmentVariables.name: READ_ONLY_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Hide all write tools (create, update, delete) (true/false)

environmentVariables.name: DRY_RUN_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Write tools only simulate changes and never modify NetBox (true/false)

environmentVariables.name: DISABLED_TAGS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool tags to disable (e.g. delete,graphql,branching)

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Logging level (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL)

environmentVariables.name: RESPONSE_MAX_SIZE
environmentVariables.description: Maximum tool response size in bytes (unset = unlimited)

environmentVariables.name: RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Enable rate limiting

environmentVariables.name: RATE_LIMIT_MAX_REQUESTS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum requests per rate limit window

environmentVariables.name: RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MINUTES
environmentVariables.description: Rate limit window in minutes

environmentVariables.name: TOOL_SEARCH_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Enable FastMCP tool search transform

environmentVariables.name: TOOL_SEARCH_STRATEGY
environmentVariables.description: Tool search strategy (bm25 or regex)

environmentVariables.name: TOOL_SEARCH_MAX_RESULTS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum tool search results returned by search_tools
